submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Production game single-frame repair, mountain guardian boy run N frame12. Preserve the exact FULL SQUARE canvas, transparent margins, character size, camera, identity and upper-body pose of reference1. Use reference1 as edit target, reference2 as the adjacent SAME-DIRECTION stance frame for the SAME character (contact anatomy and ground plane only), reference3 identity portrait, reference4 corresponding N idle for view/outfit/held-item identity only (do NOT copy its ambiguous old boot toes), reference5 approved painted style.
Primary correction: create an independently drawn true stance pose in NORTH, straight away from camera toward image top. This is the FOURTH and final WEIGHT-BEARING stance frame for the anatomical LEFT leg, AFTER reference2. In the original target that foot is already airborne exposing a full sole: correct it to still support the body. The screen-LEFT leg extends only gently from its preceding knee bend; hip/pelvis weight passes over that leg, ankle stable. Keep its forefoot AND most of the outsole in firm contact with the SAME invisible ground plane as reference2. Its heel may begin a very small unload, but the toe/ball is visibly planted, not lifted, and the boot must NOT display the whole underside toward camera. Show its brown rear heel counter and only a narrow gold outsole rim, with a subtle flat contact edge. The other leg is a free bent recovery leg; keep its original transition pose. Distinct late-stance push, not a duplicate of reference2, not a leap.
Foot anatomy: parallel to NORTH travel into depth, toes hidden beyond the shins. The planted boot must read as a BACK heel with a narrow vertical back seam/heel wall, not the front toe cap facing the viewer. No front-facing golden arrow or arched toe strap on the back heel. Keep brown leather, gold rim and green jade beads. No foot eversion: knee, shin and toe direction form a natural aligned chain; never twist the foot sideways against its knee or stand on the outer edge. Do not solve this by squeezing the two legs together.
Invariants: retain brown ponytail, gold/green armor, white trousers, wood beads, anatomical RIGHT hand long staff on screen-right and LEFT arm round shield on screen-left. Keep the original hand grip, wrist and shoulder/elbow action, full staff length and position, solid back medallion disk and transparent hole in small hanging jade ring. Most head/torso/arms/clothes remain as reference1; only necessary pelvis/leg/ankle/knee load correction is allowed. Do not enlarge/crop/recenter/mirror the figure or shift the whole image vertically. Do not copy reference2 as a duplicate or interpolate frames. Every output is one genuinely different pose. No ground drawing, shadow, motion effect, text or watermark. Square true transparent RGBA, at least1024 native. Maintain the same polished rounded game paint finish.
